text.lead: All Is Well (German: Alles ist gut) is a 2018 German drama film directed and written by Eva Trobisch.
text.cast:
- Aenne Schwarz as Janne
- Andreas Döhler as Piet
- Hans Löw as Martin
- Tilo Nest as Robert
- Lina Wendel as Sabine
- Lisa Hagmeister as Sissi
- Dagny Dewath as Tina
- Thomas Gräßle as Flori
- Annika Blendl as Madlene
- Doris Buchrucker as Frau Hanneman
- Hildegard Faust-Albrecht as Frauenärztin
- Vera Flück as Schwester Tagesklinik
- Marc-Philipp Kochendörfer as Sicherheitsbeamter
- Valentina Kühnel as Pia
- Hermann Linnenbrink as Mann auf Fahrrad
text.release:
Accolades:
Eva Trobisch won the Stockholm Film Festival 2018 award for Best Director with the motivation: "For using a "coherent and subtle film-language (portraying) a character who shrinks her own mental space until there is nothing left, trying to refuse the reality that eats her up from inside."
